readme.excerpt: Unsloth is the first desktop app to run and train models. Features • Quickstart • Notebooks • Documentation ⚡ Get started Download the native Unsloth Desktop app for your operating system: Platform Link Windows Download macOS Download Linux / Ubuntu (deb) Download Linux / Ubuntu (ARM64) (deb) Download Linux (AppImage) Download Windows (ARM64) Download Download from Unsloth or GitHub Releases. Or if you prefer to install manually: macOS, Linux, WSL: Windows: Docker: The Unsloth Docker image `unsloth/unsloth` is available on Docker. Read guide. Homebrew: Winget (Windows): If endpoint protection blocks `irm ... iex` on a managed PC, use winget. Community: - Discord - 𝕏 (Twitter) - Reddit ⭐ Features Unsloth works on Windows, Linux, WSL and macOS . We support Multi GPU setups, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, CPUs and the Vulkan backend. Run & Build with AI Run and train LLMs, MLX, GGUF, diffusion, decision, embedding, audio models: Qwen3.8, GLM-5.3-Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen-Image-2.1, MiniMax-H3, DeepSeek-V4, Gemma 4. Agents & Tools: Use local models with Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, including tool calling and code execution. Browser use: Browse sites, fill out forms, read PDFs, and edit files alongside a local-model chat. Sandboxing: Limit file access for commands your model runs. Search & RAG: Use private and unlimited web search, deep research, auto-compaction (rolling context window) and R
